integrity: The statement and formulas are established symbolically with all q>=2; finite tests are supporting checks. No independent mathematical validation or independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The midpoint arch relation for palindromes, the arch factorization, and the coupon-collector mean are previously known. The exact unconstrained ordinary-palindrome distributions and their renewal parity law are derived here; literature incompleteness may permit an unindexed equivalent. The finite verifier does not substitute for a proof and no uniform growing-alphabet claim is made.
title: Exact universality-index distributions of palindromic words over every finite alphabet
